name: Nestswipe: Container vulnerability scan failed or stale
message:
The daily scan failed, is older than 36 hours, or no longer matches the deployed image IDs. Inspect journalctl -u nestswipe-security-scan and /var/lib/nestswipe-security/scan.json. An inconclusive scan must not be treated as zero vulnerabilities.

If this check stops reporting for 20 minutes, investigate the host Agent and nestswipe-security-report.timer.
